confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on several converging sources: Saranda-specific CityCost and Himara coastal-guide figures, national averages from BearSavings, and crowd-sourced Tirana figures from Expatistan. Some sources are undated or use different currencies, and lek-to-USD conversions are approximate. Beer, cocktail and wine are less certain than the meal and coffee anchors. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates for a seasonal Ionian coastal resort in July, not based on live listings, so their confidence is low. The FX value was taken from search excerpts of rba.gov.au exchange-rate pages without a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Saranda-specific cost-of-living data (CityCost) for coffee and mid-range dinner, cross-checked against Albania national averages (BearSavings) and the Himara coastal nightlife guide for drinks. Beer also draws on Tirana neighbourhood-pub data (Expatistan). Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a Ionian coastal town in peak summer, informed by general knowledge and the regional price level.
